(to the question) The division of Daat into rooms and porticos
At the time of the Gadlut of ZA, after the third pregnancy, there is then a coupling in the brain of its Daat, which raises reflected light up to Hochma and brings its illumination out to Bina, and then the Daat receives the illumination of Hochma within its Hassadim; and likewise it turns from above downward and bestows that level upon the body. And then the Daat is divided into rooms and porticos: for HGT, which are the phase of the rooms, meaning inner chambers, he bestows the phase of covered Hassadim, for the illumination of Hochma is not revealed until the Chazeh of ZA, but only from the Chazeh downward, which is called the porticos, meaning outer chambers, where the illumination of the Hochma in the Daat is revealed. And this is what the Zohar says, that the Daat expands into the body and fills the rooms and porticos of the body — namely, that it is divided into two phases, as explained. (Part 1, Page 222, Item 244).
